objective: Turn the production-verified EVA acquisition runner into a quality-aware expert-intelligence capability: classify epistemic value at ingestion time, learn what a source has declared it cannot know, stop spending prompts on questions it cannot answer, and deposit the single-source-interrogation pattern into the Power Pack baseline.
constraints: Reuse the deep-research epistemic engine; never fork cap_epistemic or the epistemic ladder

A stored verdict must be reproducible from raw alone

No access control is bypassed; a login wall pauses durably and asks for a human
unknowns: Whether the 2,170 remaining prompts contain enough non-case-data questions to be worth the run, given 14 of 38 assessed already route to a human expert
Whether the boundary ledger saturates -- how many distinct capability limits this source actually has
Whether cohort-claim density stays near the observed 21% across families outside 00B/00C/00D
Whether account-level memory (SF30-024 referenced advice never given in this run) degrades independence measurably over a multi-hour run
candidate_questions: Does a source's declared boundary predict its answer quality on later questions in the same scope?
What is the marginal information gain per prompt once a family's boundaries are known?
